about: The Metronome item boosts a charge move's first hit by 1.2 and each later use's a fifth more (Pokemon Central, Plessimetro, from the fifth generation: the first attack, the second turn, starts at 1.2; Showdown's gen-9 item counts the hit of a twoturnmove as a use in a row). Before, the charge turn counted and the hit turn did not: 1.0 on the first hit, 1.2 on the second. A level-10 Pikachu holding the item (set:) is given Razor Wind in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Splash, its HP set to 40 before each use; the damage roll is forced to the bottom of the range: 10 with no boost, 12 with 1.2 on the first hit and 14 with 1.4 on the second (before, 10 and 12). The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
